label: Desk server
description: Owns Desk's record, desk.db, in the node's state (relay-state/process/desk/). Started by the node; reached by jobs.api on the loopback door and by an api packet from a known member (desk/G1.3).

args.name: goalFile
args.description: Where the current goal is written whole on Go, go-all, Done and session.set (goal/G3.14): a path relative to this folder, so the default lands beside desk.js, in the repo. Empty: no file is written; a server spawned with {} (every test suite) has no value and writes none.
